name: Aisia
source:
Likes: Her grandma, Santa Claus
Dislikes: Staying still, difficult stuff

According to the anime series, Aisia had once visited the Hatsune Island about fifty years ago. At that time she gave a lot of trouble to her friends.
Now, within the events of D.C.II P.C., Aisia returned to Hatsune Island after a long travel. Like [url=/c5959]Sakura[/url], she is still young, beautiful and energetic. However, the endless roams around the world and anti-social lifestyle have made her lonely. Can [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url] brighten up her solitude somehow?
